subject: Compliance ops migration credits & split-invoicing for residency/KMS
messages:
From: Caroline Turner <caroline.turner@audimed.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons — migration credits & split invoicing

Hi Irene,

Following up from our QBR — procurement asked us to get concrete on how Redwood plans to structure the compliance add-ons for residency and KMS/HSM. Two specific asks from our finance team: 

1) Can you provide an amortization schedule for any migration/onboarding credit you can offer (they care about capex vs opex treatment)?
2) We need options for split invoicing: a) capitalize implementation as a one-time CAPEX invoice or b) roll into recurring MRR as a prepaid credit. Which do you support and how do you allocate the credit across line items?

Also, is the HSM component licensed per HSM instance or per-environment? Our legal needs clarity before redlining. I've attached the RFP summary and procurement timeline.

Procurement would like something formal by end of week so they can include it in the vendor evaluation. Can you loop in pricing/ops if helpful?

Thanks,
Caroline Turner
Head of Cloud Ops
Audimed Health

Attachment: audimed_rfp_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Turner <caroline.turner@audimed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Compliance add-ons — migration credits & split invoicing

Hi Caroline — great to hear. Thanks for the clear asks. High-level answers below and I attached a line-item workbook with two packaging options. If procurement prefers, we can convert the summary into a single-sheet amendment for DocuSign.

Summary proposal (two paths):

Option A — Capitalized implementation (one-time invoice):
- Implementation SOW fee: billed as one-time CAPEX.
- Residency activation: one-time license + onboarding.
- Migration credit: Redwood provides a $30,000 migration credit applied as a contra-invoice to the implementation line (reduces CAPEX). Credit is measurable and not tied to usage.

Option B — Prepaid recurring credit (preserves OPEX):
- Implementation SOW fee: billed, but 50% offset by a revenue credit spread evenly across first 12 months of recurring invoices (reduces MRR).
- Residency licensing and KMS seats billed as recurring.
- Migration credit is amortized monthly as an invoice credit — we can provide the amort schedule for accounting.

HSM/KMS licensing model:
- KMS key management (software-managed): recurring per-environment (org-level).
- HSM (procured hardware-backed): licensed per HSM instance.
- If you expect multiple clusters, we can offer a tier (1–3 instances) with stepped pricing.

Proposed compromise to speed procurement:
- We can increase upfront migration credit to $40,000 if Audimed commits to a 12-month residency minimum and signs the attached SOW before 2027-06-30. Alternatively, hold the $30k credit and spread it across invoices per Option B if you need OPEX treatment.

I attached 'line_item_breakdown.xlsx' and a CSV of the compliance pricing table. Ben — can you confirm whether Sales Ops is comfortable with the $40k conditional offer and the proposed amortization granularity?

Next steps: 1) Procurement confirms preference (CAPEX vs OPEX) 2) We convert chosen option into amendment + invoice schedule 3) Execute SOW.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: line_item_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx); redwood_compliance_pricing_table.csv (csv)

From: Procurements Team <procure@audimed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — migration credits & split invoicing

Irene, Marissa —

Thanks for the quick outline. A couple of clarifying items from procurement: 

- We prefer to capitalize the implementation and then amortize internally as CAPEX across our depreciation schedule. If Redwood can issue a single one-time invoice with the reduced net amount (post-credit), that is simplest for our auditors.
- If you must spread the credit into recurring invoices, we need a 3-quarter maximum amortization window (not 12 months) for audit purposes.
- For HSM licensing: please confirm if that is a subscription seat or attached to the physical HSM vendor serials. We need the model because our asset management team tracks serials for hardware.

Procurement also asked for the price floor (non-negotiable minimum) for the combined residency+HSM bundle and any blackout dates for credit eligibility. Finally, please provide a DocuSign-ready amendment (SOW + payment schedule) that we can circulate.

Thanks — we aim to complete vendor selection by 2027-06-25.

— Audimed Procurement

Caroline / Procurement team —

Appreciate the clarity. We discussed internally and here's a revised, signable offer designed to match Audimed's audit preferences and procurement schedule. Key points: 

1) One-time implementation invoice (preferred by Audimed):
- Implementation SOW (one-time): $120,000 — Invoice net after migration credit.
- Migration credit: $30,000 applied as a contra to the implementation invoice, resulting in a net one-time invoice of $90,000. (If Audimed signs by 2027-06-30 we can increase the credit to $40,000 and net to $80,000.)

2) Residency & KMS/HSM licensing (recurring):
- Residency license: $8,500/month (covers up to 3 regions).
- KMS (software-managed): $2,000/month per environment.
- HSM (hardware-backed): $1,200/month per HSM instance (or billed annually as a seat license at $12,000/yr).

3) Split invoicing options (choose one):
- Option 1 (procurement preference): single one-time implementation invoice with migration credit applied (CAPEX-friendly).
- Option 2 (accounting preference): we will apply the migration credit as invoice credits spread equally across the first 3 monthly invoices (max 3 months per your audit request).

4) Price floor / blackout:
- Price floor for combined residency+HSM bundle: $100,000 ARR equivalent.
- Credit eligibility blackout: credit only applies if SOW is executed before 2027-06-30 and onboarding completed within 90 days.

Attachments: DocuSign-ready amendment and itemized workbook (links below). If this matches you, we'll issue the DocuSign amendment today and target signature by 06/24 to keep procurement timeline intact.
